content_of_post_to_comment:
I’ve been watching Disney+ instead of YouTube lately, and weirdly, it feels much better.
I know I’m still staring at a screen, so it’s not exactly “digital detox,” but there’s a big difference.
On YouTube, I can easily spend hours jumping from one random video to another without even remembering what I watched.
With Disney+, I actually choose a movie or a show, watch it, and then I’m done.
It feels less like endless consumption and more like actually deciding what I want to watch.
Has anyone else replaced YouTube or short-form content with movies/TV shows? Did it help you?
comment: I noticed the same thing when I switched from feeds to longer-form stuff. The screen time didn’t disappear, but the “what did I even just watch?” feeling did. I think the difference is having a clear stopping point. A movie ends, a series episode ends, but YouTube is basically designed to remove the moment where you decide to stop.
